features.title: Product Platform
features.paragraph: Guided by the principles of Inspire, Explore, Innovate, and Share, we deliver an embodied intelligence product platform that unifies hardware, software, curriculum, and services for seamless teaching, research, and deployment.

featuredProducts.title: Curated Product Pathways
featuredProducts.description: We highlight three representative solutions covering activation, advanced courses, and research scenarios—helping teams launch embodied intelligence programs faster.
featuredProducts.ctaDescription: Need the full catalog tailored to your teaching or research plans?

highlights.title: General Cognition - M Series
highlights.description:
Modular Embodied Composite Robot Innovation Platform
Covers all configurations of embodied AI robots, providing users with a comprehensive understanding of embodied AI technology. Designed for zero-foundation robot design learners.

highlights.title: Functional Design - P Series
highlights.description: Deeply deconstructs embodied AI technology, allowing users to deeply understand embodied composite robot technology. Positioned for higher education and scientific research scenarios.

highlights.title: Innovative Application - X Series
highlights.description: Practical operational robots based on scenario applications, positioned for scientific research and industry application scenarios.

sectionOne.title: About UNI Robotics
sectionOne.description: UNI Robotics Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is located in the Winter Olympics Plaza at Shougang Park, Shijingshan District, Beijing, partnering with Shougang Group to build a world-leading embodied intelligence innovation platform. We focus on applying embodied intelligent robotics technology to teaching and research, continuously exploring practical application scenarios, and providing integrated hardware, software, and curriculum robotics products for universities, vocational colleges, and K12 institutions.

items.title: PBL Project-Based Learning
items.paragraph: Focuses on cultivating students' ability to solve real-world problems. Creates a U-shaped learning system from discovering industry problems → analyzing task scenarios → learning challenges → building solutions with modular products → forming real problem-solving abilities.

items.title: Tiered Curriculum System
items.paragraph: Systematically analyzing embodied robotics technology and tailoring content to different educational levels, we design progressive, diverse curricula that make learning gradual and accessible.

items.title: Open-Source Ecosystem
items.paragraph: Continuously building an open-source online learning community that aggregates quality teaching resources and technical documentation, promoting the popularization and development of embodied intelligent robotics education.
